title: Don't Retrain, Remix: Adaptation of Web Agents using Mixture Hypernetworks
abstract: arXiv:2610.22539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The web is not static or uniform. Websites that serve the same purpose can look and navigate very differently. Even within a single site, successive redesigns can change how familiar features are presented and accessed. Humans adapt to this by recognizing familiar interaction patterns and reusing what they already know. We give web agents a similar ability with WebMix, a mixture hypernetwork that adapts them to unseen interfaces by composing previously trained low-rank adapters. WebMix begins with a bank of adapters trained on source interfaces. At deployment, a scout agent explores the target interface and summarizes its observations into a compact manual. A lightweight router uses this manual to predict mixing coefficients over the adapter bank, which combine the existing adapters into a new one for inference. translated_title: 无需重新训练，只需重新组合：利用混合超网络适配网页智能体
translated_abstract: 互联网并非静态或统一的。服务于相同目的的网站在外观和导航方式上可能差异巨大。即使在同一网站内部， successive redesigns 也会改变熟悉功能的呈现和访问方式。人类通过识别熟悉的交互模式并复用已有知识来适应这种变化。我们通过 WebMix 赋予网页智能体类似的能力，这是一个混合超网络，通过组合先前训练好的低秩适配器使智能体适应未见过的界面。WebMix 从一个在源界面上训练的适配器库开始。在部署时，一个侦察智能体探索目标界面，并将其观察结果总结为一份紧凑的手册。一个轻量级路由器使用该手册预测适配器库上的混合系数，将现有适配器组合成一个新的适配器用于推理。适应新界面只需一次侦察运行和一次前向传播，无需在目标上进行梯度更新。基于 Qwen 和（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: WebMix 提出混合超网络方法，通过侦察智能体生成界面手册并由轻量级路由器组合预训练的低秩适配器，使网页智能体仅需一次侦察和一次前向传播（无需任何梯度更新）即可适应未见过的网页界面。
en_tdlr: WebMix is a mixture hypernetwork that adapts web agents to unseen interfaces by routing over a bank of pre-trained low-rank adapters, requiring only a scouting run and a forward pass without any gradient updates.
